anomalies.description: A woman is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible in frame f12 (10.0s) and the recoil/position confirms discharge.
A man in dark clothing engages in physical combat with the woman; he is seen lunging or striking in f5 (10.5s) and f6 (11.0s), and appears to be thrown or falling in f8 (12.0s).
A person lies motionless on the floor (f9, f10), suggesting they have been incapacitated; another figure is partially visible above them, consistent with post-assault positioning.
A person lies supine on a tiled floor, appearing incapacitated or injured, while another individual looms over them holding a handgun (visible in f2–f3), indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

A man in a dark suit points a handgun directly at the camera; the muzzle is visible and appears to be firing or has just fired, indicated by the bright flash/reflection at the barrel tip in frame f14 and the motion blur/defocus in f15 suggesting recoil or rapid movement post-discharge.
A man points a gun (frame f6), then appears distressed (f7–f8); simultaneously, the woman reacts and engages in armed confrontation (f9–f14), indicating mutual armed combat.
A woman is lying on the ground, aiming and firing a handgun with visible muzzle flash and intense facial expression indicating active discharge.
A man in a suit holds a handgun in his right hand, mouth open in shock or shouting, suggesting he has just fired or is reacting to gunfire; the gun is pointed downward but held in a ready posture.
A man in a dark coat is seen holding a handgun and firing it while standing in a doorway; muzzle flash or recoil motion is implied by his posture and the immediate subsequent fall.
The man in the suit is shown falling backward through a doorway, with debris scattered on the floor, indicating he was struck or thrown during a physical confrontation.

The man who fired the gun is shown falling backward onto the floor, suggesting he was struck or reacted violently; a woman then appears in the next frames engaging in physical struggle, indicating mutual combat.

A woman is on the ground, visibly injured (blood on face), holding a gun, then appears to be struck or overpowered; her facial expression and posture indicate she is being attacked while incapacitated.

After being shot, the man stumbles and appears to engage in physical struggle or defensive movement against the shooter (visible in f13–f15), though direct mutual combat is not fully resolved in frames.
A woman is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible in frame f4 (10.0s), and the recoil/position suggests discharge.
A man in dark clothing engages in physical combat with the woman; he is seen lunging or striking in f5 (10.5s) and f6 (11.0s), and appears to be thrown or falling in f8 (12.0s).
A person lies motionless on the floor (f9, f10), suggesting they have been incapacitated; another figure is partially visible above them, consistent with post-assault positioning.

A man in a dark suit points a handgun directly at the camera; the muzzle is visible and appears to be firing or has just fired, indicated by the bright flash/reflection at the barrel tip in frame f14 and the motion blur/defocus in f15 suggesting recoil or rapid movement post-discharge.
A person lies supine on a tiled floor, appearing incapacitated or injured, while another individual looms over them holding a handgun (visible in f2–f3), indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A woman is lying on the ground, aiming and firing a handgun with visible muzzle flash and intense facial expression indicating active discharge.
A man points a gun (frame f6), then appears distressed (f7–f8); simultaneously, the woman reacts and engages in armed confrontation (f9–f14), indicating mutual armed combat.
A woman is lying on the ground, holding a handgun with both hands and aiming it forward; her facial expression is intense and aggressive, consistent with actively firing or preparing to fire.
A man in a suit holds a handgun in his right hand, mouth open in shock or shouting, suggesting he has just fired or is reacting to gunfire; the gun is pointed downward but held in a ready posture.
The man in the suit is shown falling backward through a doorway, with debris scattered on the floor, indicating he was struck or thrown during a physical confrontation.
A man in a dark coat is seen holding a handgun and firing it while standing in a doorway; muzzle flash or recoil motion is implied by his posture and the immediate subsequent fall.

The man who fired the gun is shown falling backward onto the floor, suggesting he was struck or reacted violently; a woman then appears in the next frames engaging in physical struggle, indicating mutual combat.

A woman is on the ground, visibly injured (blood on face), holding a gun, then appears to be struck or overpowered; her facial expression and posture indicate she is being attacked while incapacitated.
